stock-feed-redfox v1.0.0

- Initial release of the A股社媒短讯研究工具 (A-shares social media news research tool)
- Searches and analyzes A股-related short news across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and WeChat Official Accounts using 17 built-in core keywords (default: past 7 days)
- Cross-platform data comparison and sentiment analysis with structured report output in JSON and interactive HTML
- Built-in public/free API key; supports personal API key configuration
- Customizable options: keywords, platforms, time range (1–30 days), output format and directory
- Integrated pre- and post-analysis using WebSearch for trend and context enrichment
